headline: Bank of Japan Holds Policy Rates Steady and Signals Future Hikes
summary: The Bank of Japan kept its benchmark interest rates unchanged at its monetary policy meeting while signaling that further interest rate increases remain on the table.
why: The Bank of Japan is normalizing monetary policy after decades of ultra-loose settings, which influences the yen, Japanese government bond yields, and global carry trades.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: A rate pause relieves short-term yield pressure, but hawkish forward guidance signals continued policy tightening.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank opted to hold rates steady while maintaining a tightening bias, stabilizing currency and sovereign bond yields in line with analyst expectations.
